QuestInfo.name: The Little Prince that Loves the Stars
QuestInfo.0: You remember seeing a boy sitting in the middle of the desert with a rose. He must not have been thirsty, because he kept worrying about the rose. Is he doing alright?
QuestInfo.1: The strange boy is gazing up at the sky, explaining sadly that he can't see a star. A star? What star is he looking at? You feel sad watching him, so you promise to get him #b#t4000333#s#k from #r#o2100108#s#k so he can see his star.  \n\n#i4000333# #t4000333#  #b#c4000333##k/20
QuestInfo.2: After you gave that strange boy the #t4000333#s, he flashed that bright smile of his. He said he's from a different planet... what does he mean? Is he an alien? He's hard to understand, but seeing him smile like that made you feel less weird about him.
